output: html_document
---


```{r}
library(here)
```


```{r params}
module = "beige_vs_white"
method_name = "fastmnn"
dataname = paste0("tss_",method_name)
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "tss_fastmnn_monocle_umap_plots"
i_am(file.path("analysis", module, paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
```

```{r}
g2g = read.table(here(odir, "g2g_alignment_genes.tsv"), header = T)
head(g2g, n=20)
```


```{r}
ggplot(g2g, aes(x=l2fc, y=alignment_similarity_percentage)) + geom_point() +
    geom_text_repel(data=filter(g2g, !grepl("^D|,", Gene) &
                                    (alignment_similarity_percentage <=0.5 | 
                                          (abs_l2fc > 0.1 & alignment_similarity_percentage < 1))
                                    ),
                    aes(label=gsub("P:","",Gene)))
```


```{r}
summary(g2g)
```
